step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify the external actor 'USERS' (UserConsumerWeb) accessing the application.
2. User requests arrive at CloudFront CDN.
3. CloudFront routes web requests to an EC2 instance running Varnish cache, and serves static content directly from S3.
4. EC2 (Varnish) forwards uncached requests to the Magento application hosted on EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service).
5. EKS pulls Docker images from ECR (Elastic Container Registry).
6. EKS interacts with Aurora MySQL database for transactional business data.
7. EKS caches data in ElastiCache (Redis).
8. EKS mounts S3 as a file system using S3Fuse for file storage.
